title: They Need Looking After
description:
Animals here aren't scenery. Each one tracks **happiness, hunger, thirst, grooming** and can fall **sick** if neglected.

A well-kept animal breeds better and produces more. A neglected one gets ill and stops earning its feed.

**Domesticate** an animal by feeding it the food it prefers. Domesticated animals are calmer and easier to manage.

Feeding troughs hold food and water so a large herd doesn't need hand-feeding.
